# Repository guidance for GitHub Copilot

This is a focused PipeWire USB microphone investigation with one source patch; it is not a full PipeWire checkout. Read `README.md` first, then use `HOW_TO_USE.md`, `GLOSSARY.md`, `AI_CONTEXT.md`, and `problem.yaml` as needed.

Keep technical claims tied to the tested DCMT microphone (`31b2:0011`) and Intel H61 host. Distinguish direct ALSA observations from the patched PipeWire runtime check. Do not describe the result as universal or claim automated tests ran. Preserve the patch's capture-only and no-explicit-ACP-format conditions.
